name: keymaster
description: Secret tripwire: masks API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys in tool output before Claude, the transcript or your screen sees them, says so in a toast, and counts saves in the status line. /keymaster lists what was masked (kind and place, never the value).

skipTools.title: Tools left unscanned
skipTools.description: Tool names (globs) whose output is passed through untouched.

warnCommands.title: Hint before risky commands
warnCommands.description: Adds a note for Claude after commands that tend to dump secrets (docker inspect without --format, cat .env, printenv, Arr config.xml).
